name: Brooklyn Interns for Arts and Culture (BIAC)
what_you_do: A paid, year-long after-school internship for 13 students. You learn what it takes to work in arts management and get help planning life after high school.
who_can_apply: Rising seniors at a high school in any of the five boroughs. You need an interest in the arts, a GPA of 2.0 or higher, and an unofficial transcript.
pay_detail: The page says the internship is paid. The amount is not stated.
duration: One year in 3 sessions: one week in August (Mon to Fri, 11 a.m. to 3 p.m.), October to December, and February to June (1 to 2 days a week, 4 to 6 p.m.). The 2026-27 cohort runs Aug 2026 to Jun 2027.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 application closed Friday, June 12, 2026. The next deadline is not posted.
how_to_apply: Use the Enroll button on the BAM BIAC page, which links to an online form. The page lists the Education Program Manager for questions. Include an unofficial high school transcript.
notes: Only 13 spots. After the program, BAM Education alumni ages 18 to 24 can join a separate paid Creative Career Collective (virtual, Oct to Dec). Pay amount and work-permit rules are not on the page.
